content:
Create a new integration. The new integration key and secret key are randomly
generated and returned in the response. This endpoint cannot create non-generic Duo
Single Sign-On applications. Requires "Grant applications" API permission.
We recommend using the v3 create endpoint as it includes a parameter for configuring
user access.
Note: This API call uses POST data, which must be represented as JSON and cannot be
passed in via URL parameters. Some Duo clients (Python or Java, for example) offer
helper functions to handle requests to the Admin API.
